rationale: The short setup remains technically valid because price is still below session VWAP and has not reached the $19.13 invalidation level. Recent 1-minute candles have ticked higher to the 9-EMA, but that is not enough to invalidate the failed-bounce short thesis. The distance to invalidation is small relative to the distance to the $18.82 take-profit, so holding preserves favorable asymmetry without flipping into a weak-tape long.
